findings.finding: Slides 3, 4, 8, 9, 11, 12 have no quantitative encoding; visuals are conceptual/synthesis diagrams. No factual-contract risk.

findings.resolution: enforced in visual-inventory.json; task 2.1 will verify DOM-structural independence

findings.finding: Slide 14 39% must not be encoded as 'caused by AI'; must retain qualifier. Avoid green unless palette/accessibility contract allows it.
findings.resolution: enforced in visual-inventory.json; use shape, sign, labels, position as meaning carriers

findings.finding: Slide 3 described as 'bar' implies unstated denominator. Safer: large numeric anchor + horizon label only.
findings.resolution: inventory corrected: 'NOT a bar. No axis, no baseline, no comparison'

findings.finding: SVG text must be >= 18px at authored 1280x720 stage AND legible at projected 1366x768 viewport.
findings.resolution: task 3.1 checks computed font size at both sizes

findings.finding: Icons/symbols in slide 8 risk color-only meaning or cross-platform rendering variance.
findings.resolution: all icons must have Vietnamese text labels; CSS/SVG geometry over Unicode glyphs

findings.finding: No photographic images unless provenance/license is recorded. SVG/CSS symbolic illustrations preferred.
Research retention statistics (65% vs 10%, 60000x faster) are marketing claims and should not enter deck or proposal as evidence.
